name: OpenVibe.Exchange

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the PostgreSQL database, Valkey, Network's JWKS and the Events subscriptions are what /api/ready checks)

drains: HTTP server closed and in-flight requests drained
telemetry interval and retention stopped, then the telemetry buffer flushed
PostgreSQL pool closed, then the Events subscriptions stopped

resumes.what: exchange_outbox rows committed with a listing change survive a stop under their fixed evt_ ids; v1 has no relay yet, so unpublished documents wait for Search's document writer rather than being sent at boot
listings, tests, trials, installs and offers live in PostgreSQL; a restart reopens the pool, and an install keeps the passport snapshot it was made with
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop; account_data_events applies each once, so a redelivery changes nothing

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Exchange's own tables (listings, tests, status events, sandbox trials, installs, offers, outbox, account-data receipts, telemetry); an earlier release reads none of them

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site and the API

notes: Port 5150, unit openvibe-exchange.service, database ov_exchange. The Exchange is the network's AI: every model one account, the live price, speed and uptime of every offer, chat with one model or three side by side, blind Arena rankings, companions, a private GPU endpoint and one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint. The public pages of OpenVibe.AI live here since 2026-11-07. It reads OpenVibe.AI's public Exchange API (catalog, usage, community offers) and keeps chats, companion memory, shares and the daily catalog snapshot in PostgreSQL. v1's listings are retired: their pages answer 410 and their tables stay read-only. OAuth client `exchange`; answers account export and deletion (ADR-033) and subscribes to the two account Events topics.

site.name: Exchange
site.what: Models, keys, usage, search and deployments. Try models in Chat; compare and vote on Report.
